This is a React + TypeScript Vite project for Reachinbox Email Aggregator. Use Material UI for UI components, Axios for API calls, and implement all features listed in the assignment spec. Scaffold feature folders for auth, dashboard, emails, accounts, settings, components, hooks, and utils. Use a modern SaaS look (white, purple/blue accents).
